name: Talondeep Vale
summary: In south-central Ashenvale, Talondeep Vale lies between familiar landmarks and the road to the mountains.

sections.title: A Sheltered Valley
sections.body: Talondeep Vale lies beneath the trees of south-central Ashenvale. Silverwind Refuge stands to the east, and the Ruins of Stardust lie nearby. To the south, the land rises toward the Stonetalon Mountains. Travelers cross this wooded valley between the heart of Ashenvale and the high crags beyond.

faq.answer: Talondeep Vale lies in south-central Ashenvale, between Silverwind Refuge, the Ruins of Stardust, and the southern pass into the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Where does the path leading south through the vale go?
faq.answer: The trail through Talondeep Vale leads to Talondeep Path, which climbs through the rugged heights connecting Ashenvale’s woodlands with the arid peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What nearby landmarks should travelers watch for?
faq.answer: Silverwind Refuge lies to the east, and the Ruins of Stardust stand nearby beneath the trees.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the paths near Mystral Lake and the Ruins of Stardust, familiar ground in southern Ashenvale.
